A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same study and contain 17 pages, including appendices A–D. Text and visual inspection support comparison of the methods, equations, results and supplementary material; relocated content is identifiable.

before.justification: V1 reports original story-generation experiments over 50 premises and human-rated interactive-drama experiments involving 10 human and 10 agent players, with quantitative results and qualitative cases.

after.justification: V2 retains these original experiments and their results in Tables 2–6, including revised numerical entries.

M1.justification: Section 4.4 changes the stated memory procedure from scene-end summarization with full within-scene history to retaining and flattening all memories in the prompt. The generation algorithm, plot-based reflection and architecture-switching procedure remain unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same 50-premise story-generation coverage and three-scene Detective Conan script, with human and aggressive-agent players. The script and player personalities in appendices C–D are unchanged.

E2.justification: Tables 2–4 retain the same vanilla Qwen2.5-72b/GPT-4o, Outline-First, ablated-generation and role-architecture comparisons. The missing Hybrid Architecture label in v2 does not indicate removal of its result row or method.

E3.justification: Section 4.4 revises the reported preprocessing of agent histories from scene summaries to flattened full memory. Evaluation sample sizes, annotators, metrics and playing counts remain unchanged; the PDFs do not establish that experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: Table 3 revises the critic-and-revise ablation evidence: the technique-following rates now favor the full method rather than its ablation. The ablation design, refinement comparison, sampling analysis, aggressive-player robustness comparison and reflection cases otherwise remain unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions report best/worst proportions and average human ratings using the same playing protocol. Neither adds seed information, repeated-run uncertainty, confidence intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: Table 2 corrects the proposed method's suspense rate from 21 (21%) to 21 (42%) among 50 stories. Table 3 changes Follow from 66% to 92% for the full method and from 92% to 66% without critic/revision. Other reported results remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The decision and reflection equations and plot-chain definitions retain their meaning. Section 4.1 reorganizes the explanation of player input xt without changing the mathematics; no formal assumptions or proofs are added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's two contributions and conclusion retain the same claims: improve immersion through playwriting-guided generation and agency through plot-based reflection, assessed using human judgment.

C2.justification: The Limitations section replaces the explicit warning about GPT-4o-only experiments and absent broader-model validation with a warning that the memory system is outdated. Existing interpretations, reflection failure explanations and the gap between the two evaluation stages remain unchanged.

D1.justification: The memory implementation instructions in Section 4.4 are revised. Other disclosed parameters, appendix prompts, demonstration script and player-personality instructions remain unchanged. The repository destination is retained; its expanded footnote does not establish changed resource availability.

R1.justification: Section 2 adds Riedl (2016) and connects the work to computational creativity through Wiggins (2006), Gervás (2009), and Colton and Wiggins (2012). The principal novelty and comparison positioning remain unchanged.

P1.justification: V2 updates affiliations and the funding/contact footnote, clarifies the Table 3 caption and edits several sentences. It also drops Hybrid Architecture from several sentences, leaving incomplete wording. The overall narrative and section ordering remain stable.

P2.justification: All figures and tables are retained. Figure 4 moves from page 6 to page 7, Table 5 changes column, and pagination reflows. V2 expands Table 3's caption but loses Hybrid Architecture from Figure 3's caption and Table 4's row label.

improvement.justification: V2 resolves Table 2's arithmetic error and makes Table 3's critic-ablation values consistent with the accompanying interpretation, improving internal consistency of the empirical reporting. Clearer win-rate explanations and added research context also help. These limited gains are tempered by missing architecture labels, the unexplained memory revision and removal of the explicit broader-model-validation caveat.
